title: 第7章 老娘还没给你功法呢你怎么就突破了第8章 鸡肉味嘎嘣脆
content_zh:
;;
【您选择与苏沐雪分摊房租，苏沐雪虽然表情厌恶，但最后还是答应负责六成的房租。】
【苏沐雪好感度+2】
原来房租四六开是我四你六啊。
作为一个直男，这点云阳比较满意。
但特么为毛你好感度增加了两点？
收房租增加好感度？这是什么鬼原因？
而且还是在表情厌恶的情况下增加的好感度？
抖m+傲傲傲傲傲傲娇？
这什么奇怪的属性。
云阳表示无法理解。
只能说你们修仙的可真会玩。
摇了摇头，云阳继续看向游戏新弹出来的文字提示。
【已加入玄天门，是否凭借身份令牌前往藏经阁获取修炼功法？】
确定确定，这个肯定想都不用想啊，我特么玩这个游戏不就是等着来修仙的嘛。
【已获得玄天门炼气期修炼功法：归元诀】
【已开启新功能：修炼】
【已开启新属性：寿命】
【已开启新属性：灵根】
【现玩家可以以日或者月为单位选择跳过时间。】

【注意事项1：灵根属性越少，天赋越高】
【注意事项2：每当修炼境界达到下一个阶段时，可获得寿命属性，请在寿命结束前修炼至下一阶段，否则您将死亡。】
【注意事项3：修炼境界分为：练气期—筑基期—结丹期—元婴期—化神期—炼虚期—合体期—大乘期】
哦豁！可以修仙了！
【检测到玩家气属性为100，已将修炼境界提升至练气期一层。】
忽然，云阳感知到从自己小腹处涌现出一股力量，随即，这股力量沿着体内的经脉延伸到四肢百骸，在体内缓缓流淌起来。
同时，云阳脑海里还出现了一些陌生的知识，这些知识好像就是运转体内那些能量的知识。
这应该就是那个炼气期的修炼功法——归元诀了。
“嘶~”
云阳不禁倒吸了一口凉气。
我尼玛，我特么真成修仙者了？
当即，云阳便开始尝试修炼脑海中的功法。
然而……
云阳并没有在空中感知到半分灵力。
……
好吧，想在现实世界修炼果然是想多了。
啧，云阳撇了撇嘴，怎么我这想努力努力都不行呢？
非得让我靠外挂是吧？
真的是，本来我都不想开挂的，都是你们逼的。
content_en:
;;
[You chose to share the rent with Su Muxue. Although Su Muxue looked disgusted, she finally agreed to be responsible for 60% of the rent. 】
[Su Muxue’s favorability +2]
It turns out that the rent is 40 to 60, so it’s 4 to 6 for me and 6 for you.
As a straight man, Yunyang is quite satisfied with this.
But why has Mao's favorability increased by two points?
Collecting rent increases favorability? What the hell is the reason for this?
And it’s also the increase in favorability when the expression is disgusting?
Shake m+Aoaoaoaoaoaojiao?
What a strange attribute.
Yunyang said he couldn't understand.
I can only say that you cultivators are really good at playing.
Shaking his head, Yunyang continued to look at the new text prompt that popped up in the game.
[Having joined Xuantianmen, do you want to use your identity token to go to the Sutra Pavilion to obtain the cultivation techniques? 】
Sure, sure, you don’t have to think about this. I’m just waiting to become an immortal by playing this game.
[Have obtained Xuantianmen’s Qi-refining period practice technique: Guiyuan Jue]
[New function enabled: practice]
[New attribute has been opened: lifespan]
[New attribute has been opened: spiritual root]
[Now players can choose to skip time in days or months. 】
[Note 1: The fewer spiritual root attributes, the higher the talent]
[Note 2: Whenever the cultivation realm reaches the next stage, you can obtain the lifespan attribute. Please practice to the next stage before the end of your lifespan, otherwise you will die. 】
[Note 3: The realm of cultivation is divided into: Qi training period - foundation building period - elixir formation stage - Nascent Soul stage - spirit transformation stage - void refining stage - integration stage - Mahayana stage]
Oh haha! You can become an immortal now!
[It is detected that the player's vitality attribute is 100, and the cultivation level has been raised to the first level of Qi training stage. 】
Suddenly, Yunyang felt a force emerging from his lower abdomen. Immediately, this force extended along the meridians in the body to the limbs and bones, slowly flowing through the body.
At the same time, some unfamiliar knowledge appeared in Yunyang's mind. This knowledge seemed to be the knowledge that circulated the energy in the body.
This should be the cultivation method of that Qi refining period - Guiyuan Jue.
"Hiss~"
Yunyang couldn't help but take a breath of cold air.
Damn it, have I really become an immortal cultivator?
Immediately, Yunyang began to try to practice the technique in his mind.
However...
Yunyang didn't sense any spiritual power in the air.
…
Well, thinking about practicing in the real world is really overthinking.
Tsk, Yunyang curled his lips, why can’t I even try as hard as I want?
You have to let me rely on plug-ins, right?
Really, I didn’t want to cheat in the first place, but you forced me to do so.
